title: Treatment Selection in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma: A Conceptual Framework for Precision Therapy.
snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains a major therapeutic challenge, with limited improvement in outcomes and substantial heterogeneity in treatment response.
